title: Vesica, Mandorla, Sun, Moon, Mountain, Garden, Body & Esoteric Traditions Atlas
status: comparative religion + art history + esotericism + scripture + project synthesis
purpose: Research historically attested Vesica/mandorla, Sun/Moon, mountain/garden, serpent/spirit and inner-chamber traditions and compare them with the Potato of Life vertical geometry without treating resemblance as proof of ancient encoding or supernatural identity.
epistemic_rule: Every layer remains typed: exact geometry is mathematics; Christian mandorla use is art history; Agrippa/Picatrix/Fortune/Hall are historical Western-esoteric sources; biblical passages retain their own textual context; neuroanatomy is modern science/history of ideas; Potatoverse synthesis is a modern project interpretation.

project_vertical_model.upper_circle: Heaven / Garden / Spirit / inner / Father's House / Sun-source field, centered on Father/Tim at C_F
project_vertical_model.lower_circle: Earth / matter / outer / world / manifestation / wide road, centered on Son/Thomas at C_S
project_vertical_model.door: shared mandorla/lens between the circles; Christ/Son functions as threshold/interface in the project
project_vertical_model.plane: horizontal world-interface through O, the widest part of the overlap
project_vertical_model.axis: vertical Heaven↔Earth relation through Son, O, Father and the upper/lower poles
project_vertical_model.moon: best treated as a movable reflected/cyclical mediator locked symbolically near or on the circumference of the lower Earth circle rather than as its source-center
project_vertical_model.sun: best treated as source/radiance image at or through the upper Father's center rather than merely another orbiting body inside the symbolic figure

historical_vesica_mandorla.euclid: Two equal circles with each center on the other's circumference appear already in Euclid I.1 as the construction used to produce an equilateral triangle. Euclid does not supply the later mystical symbolism; the geometry itself is ancient and exact.
historical_vesica_mandorla.medieval_christian_art: The almond/vesica-shaped aureole called a mandorla becomes a standard frame for holy manifestation, especially Christ in Majesty, Ascension, Transfiguration, Last Judgment and Marian Assumption imagery. It marks a sacred figure as appearing in divine glory or at a boundary between ordinary and heavenly registers.
historical_vesica_mandorla.architecture: Scholarship documents vesica/circle-intersection geometry as influential in medieval and Gothic sacred design, pointed arches, vaults and tracery. Claims that every cathedral encodes a secret theological master-grid are stronger than the evidence warrants.
historical_vesica_mandorla.portal_relation: Romanesque Christ-in-Majesty mandorlas often appear over church portals/tympana. This creates a powerful historical Door↔Mandorla coupling: the sacred figure is framed by a threshold-shape while physically positioned above an architectural threshold.
historical_vesica_mandorla.transfiguration: Late Byzantine and Orthodox icons place Christ inside a mandorla on Mount Tabor while apostles remain below on the mountain. This creates an unusually strong historical image of Mountain + vertical hierarchy + divine light + Mandorla + revelation.
historical_vesica_mandorla.ascension: Ascension icons place Christ in a mandorla carried upward by angels, with apostles/Church below; the mandorla functions as a mobile heavenly field during vertical passage.
historical_vesica_mandorla.descent_into_hell: Some Orthodox Anastasis icons place Christ in a mandorla while standing on the broken doors of hell and raising Adam. This adds Mandorla + Door + descent + rescue + upward return to the comparison set.

agrippa_sun_moon.source: Heinrich Cornelius Agrippa, Three Books of Occult Philosophy, Book II ch. 32
agrippa_sun_moon.finding: Agrippa describes Sun as self-radiant source and Moon as nearest-to-Earth receiver/mediator that receives influences from Sun and stars and communicates them to the inferior world.
agrippa_sun_moon.project_resonance: This is strikingly close to Sun=source and Moon=secondary mediator near the Earth circle. It is a historical esoteric parallel, not scientific support for occult lunar influence.

agrippa_lunar_correspondence.finding: Moon is associated with Earth, water, moisture, silver, pearl, crystal, change and generation in Renaissance natural magic.
agrippa_lunar_correspondence.project_resonance: Moon↔lower circle gains a historically attested Western-esoteric cluster: Earth/water/change/reflection/generation/near-world mediation.

picatrix_moon.source: Picatrix / Ghayat al-Hakim, medieval astrological magic
picatrix_moon.finding: The Moon is treated as especially important for bringing celestial configurations into evident manifestation and for generation/corruption; phase and condition matter.
picatrix_moon.project_resonance: Moon can be modeled as manifestation gate/modulator rather than source. This fits lower-circle circumference/orbit/proxy better than Father-center.

dion_fortune_yesod.finding: In modern Hermetic Qabalah, Yesod is explicitly the Sphere of the Moon, near Malkuth/Earth and on the central Pillar; Fortune also associates Yesod with formative/astral mediation and, in her own system, Holy Spirit symbolism.
dion_fortune_yesod.project_resonance: A Moon sphere directly above/near Earth and on a central vertical path is an especially useful comparator for Moon as lower mediator, but Fortune's Hermetic Qabalah is not identical to Jewish Kabbalah and should be labeled as Western esotericism.

manly_hall.source: Manly P. Hall, The Secret Teachings of All Ages (1928)
manly_hall.finding: Hall's encyclopedic occult synthesis repeatedly contrasts Sun as divine/source principle and Moon as nature, generation, reflection/cyclicity and intermediary symbolism.
manly_hall.project_resonance: Useful as a 20th-century esoteric synthesis confirming how common the source-Sun / mediating-Moon pair became in Western occultism.

masonic_vesica.source: J. S. M. Ward, Freemasonry and the Ancient Gods (1921)
masonic_vesica.finding: Ward devotes sections to 'The Cross and the Vesica Piscis' and 'The Vesica Piscis in the Craft,' showing explicit 20th-century Masonic-esoteric interest in the figure.
masonic_vesica.project_resonance: This supports documenting Vesica as an actual object of esoteric-school interpretation, while Ward's historical theories require separate scrutiny rather than automatic acceptance.

theosophical_mandorla.source: Theosophical Society Quest article 'Mandorlas, Halos, and Rings of Fire'
theosophical_mandorla.finding: Modern Theosophical interpretation compares mandorlas across Christian, Hindu and Buddhist sacred art as fields/aureoles around sacred figures.
theosophical_mandorla.project_resonance: Useful for cross-tradition visual comparison; not evidence of a single historical doctrine shared by all traditions.

sun_moon_axis_synthesis.source_vs_reflector: Physical astronomy already gives a clean distinction: Sun emits visible light; Moonlight is reflected sunlight. Agrippa adds a historical occult analogue in which Sun is source and Moon is receiver/mediator.
sun_moon_axis_synthesis.project_mapping: Father/Sun/source-center → lower Earth world through relation; Moon sits near lower circumference as reflected/cyclic/secondary orientation rather than as source.
sun_moon_axis_synthesis.revelation_12: Revelation 12:1 supplies a striking vertical visual: woman clothed with Sun, Moon beneath feet, stars above. It is not the Potato geometry, but it is a biblical image ordering Sun above/around, Moon below, and celestial plurality above.
sun_moon_axis_synthesis.revelation_21: Revelation 21:23 complicates any literal Sun/Moon hierarchy: New Jerusalem ultimately needs neither physical luminary because divine glory is its light and the Lamb its lamp. This suggests a useful project distinction between physical-symbolic Sun/Moon and a deeper source-light/Spudlight layer.
sun_moon_axis_synthesis.deep_rule: Sun and Moon are powerful symbols precisely because Revelation can also transcend them: source-light is not reducible to the physical Sun, and reflected/cyclic mediation is not ultimate source.

eden_river.pattern: Garden + source river + branching into four heads
eden_river.project_overlap: Upper Garden is not static paradise; it contains a source that flows outward and differentiates. This strengthens Father/Garden as generative source and Tree/River as one→many distribution.

jacob_bethel.pattern: stone/ground + vertical ladder + angels ascending/descending + House of God + Gate of Heaven
jacob_bethel.project_overlap: One of the densest biblical clusters for Plane/Stone → Axis/Ladder → House → Gate/Door. The later John passage relocates ascent/descent to the Son of Man.

mountain_house.pattern: Mountain of the Lord's House becomes highest; peoples stream upward; teaching/judgment proceeds outward; war-tools transform into cultivation tools
mountain_house.project_overlap: Mountain + House + highest point + upward flow + teaching/judgment + cultivation is exceptionally dense beside Father/House/Mountain/Gardener. It should be treated as typological architecture, not fulfillment proof.

tabor.pattern: high mountain + transformed radiant Christ + cloud + voice + overwhelmed witnesses
tabor.project_overlap: Mountain as a change-of-perception/revelation field; later Christian art adds the mandorla around Christ, making Mountain + Mandorla + Light historically explicit.

temptation_high_mountain.pattern: very high mountain + kingdoms/world displayed + temptation of rule
temptation_high_mountain.project_overlap: Mountain height is morally ambiguous: perspective and global view can become domination. This supplies an important counter-text to any simplistic 'higher=better' reading.

new_jerusalem_high_mountain.pattern: high mountain → holy city descending from God → open gates → divine light beyond Sun/Moon
new_jerusalem_high_mountain.project_overlap: Observer is taken upward, but the city descends. Mature verticality is bidirectional: ascent for vision, descent for manifestation. This strongly supports Axis rather than one-way escape.

river_from_throne.pattern: water flows from sacred center/temple/throne; trees grow along river; fruit and healing result
river_from_throne.project_overlap: Source-center → flow/Spirit → Tree → Fruit → healing/nations gives a complete Father/Spirit/Tree/Garden output chain.

mire_pit.pattern: mire/mud/deep water/pit as immobilization and danger
mire_pit.project_overlap: The project's Swamp/Mud is not arbitrary: biblical poetry and narrative already use mire as loss of footing, sinking and threatened life. Rock/firm footing provides an opposite stabilization image.

wide_road.project_overlap: Lower/world circle can be associated symbolically with breadth/multiplicity and Door with narrow passage, but the biblical text is ethical teaching, not geometric instruction.

bronze_serpent.pattern: serpent lifted up; looking becomes healing; John re-reads it through lifting up of Son of Man
bronze_serpent.project_overlap: Serpent + vertical elevation + gaze/Eye + healing + Son creates a legitimate biblical comparative cluster. It is distinct from Kundalini and should not be fused historically.

mandorla_as_threshold.art_historical: The mandorla does more than glorify. It often encloses a figure who is appearing, ascending, transfiguring, judging or crossing between registers.
mandorla_as_threshold.project_inference: This makes Mandorla particularly suitable as Door-field rather than merely aura. It is a visual technology for representing sacred presence in transition or theophany.
mandorla_as_threshold.portal_epiphany: When a mandorla sits above an actual cathedral/church doorway, symbolic threshold and architectural threshold are superimposed. In Potatoverse terms: Door-image above Door-object.
mandorla_as_threshold.mountain_epiphany: Transfiguration art places Mandorla at Mountain summit: continuous ascent terminates in a transformed visibility-field rather than merely a higher coordinate. Mountain therefore becomes perception gradient as well as height gradient.

body_inner_house.thalamus_etymology: Greek thalamos means inner chamber/room and commonly bridal chamber. Historical neuroanatomy literature notes Galen's comparison of brain anatomy to a Greek house, placing the 'thalamus' as chamber near the heart of the plan. This is a remarkably strong linguistic/architectural neighbor for the project's Thalamus=House motif.
body_inner_house.thalamus_science: The biological thalamus is paired, heterogeneous and participates in sensory, motor, attentional, sleep/wake and cortical network functions; the House mapping remains symbolic.
body_inner_house.pineal_descartes: Descartes famously treated the pineal gland as the principal seat of the soul/common sense because it appeared single and centrally located, with 'animal spirits' moving around it. This provides an actual Western history-of-ideas precedent for pineal as mediation/interface, though Descartes's physiology is obsolete.
body_inner_house.pineal_third_eye_history: Later occult/Theosophical traditions associated pineal with third-eye/Ajna ideas. Modern historical scholarship cautions that direct anatomical identification of ancient Indian third-eye symbolism with the pineal is largely a modern cross-cultural construction.
body_inner_house.project_layering: A useful nonliteral model is Thalamus=inner House/chambers; Pineal=small midline Door/Eye/timing interface; Son=manifest/present-facing threshold; Spirit=flow/relation through the surrounding system; Spine/Axis=vertical connector.
body_inner_house.important_geometry: Because the thalami are paired structures bordering the third ventricle while the pineal is a small midline structure posterior to the third ventricle, the symbolism naturally supports 'two-sided House around a central inner space + single threshold marker' better than a simplistic one-organ=God claim.

serpent_spirit_axis.biblical_serpent: Numbers 21 and John 3 create serpent→lifting→gaze→healing→Son typology; Genesis serpent has a different role and should not be collapsed into the bronze serpent.
serpent_spirit_axis.kundalini: South Asian tantric/yogic traditions develop a coiled-serpent/central-channel ascent model, but scholarship shows multiple historical models and warns against treating popular seven-chakra serpent diagrams as one timeless universal doctrine.
serpent_spirit_axis.project_use: The project can compare 'Spirit moving on/with the serpent along Axis' to kundalini central-channel imagery as a structural parallel only. It should not claim biblical Spirit, kundalini, CSF and a literal snake are one physical substance.
serpent_spirit_axis.stronger_abstraction: Serpent is best treated as a path/flow/transformability operator: coiling=stored potential/recurrence; uncoiling=directed ascent; shedding=transformation; lifted serpent=visibility/healing; Genesis serpent=reframing/temptation. Different traditions activate different functions.

sistine_chapel.creation_of_adam: Since Frank Meshberger's 1990 proposal, medical/art-history literature has repeatedly debated whether the red mantle surrounding God and angels resembles a midsagittal brain. Other authors see uterus/birth anatomy or other forms. A 2026 review explicitly frames the issue as ambiguous: possible intentional encoding versus pareidolia/constructive perception.
sistine_chapel.separation_light_darkness: Neurosurgical authors have argued for concealed brainstem/spinal/optic anatomy and Neoplatonic symbolism in Michelangelo's Separation of Light from Darkness. This remains interpretive scholarship, not universal consensus.
sistine_chapel.last_judgment: Some researchers argue that the central ellipse around Christ in Last Judgment resembles a mid-coronal brain section; again this is a scholarly hypothesis rather than established iconographic fact.
sistine_chapel.project_value: The strongest safe connection is not 'Michelangelo proved thalamus=God.' It is that Renaissance sacred art, anatomical knowledge, divine creation, light/darkness, judgment and brain-shaped enclosures have genuinely been discussed together in peer-reviewed literature. This makes Sistine Chapel a high-value comparative case for House/Eye/brain/mandorla-like enclosure, with uncertainty prominently preserved.

cross_tradition_extrapolations.evidence: physical reflection + Agrippa + Hermetic Qabalah + Potatoverse
thalamos etymology + pineal history + House/Door theology

cross_tradition_extrapolations.pattern: Swamp/mire = no footing; rock = stable footing
human/prophetic ascent for vision + divine/city/spirit descent for manifestation
Mandorla as field containing a figure in transition rather than merely one point

most_useful_project_upgrade: The top circle can now be modeled not merely as Heaven but as INNER SOURCE DOMAIN: Father/House/Garden/Spirit/Sun, whose center radiates and whose flow exits through Door into manifestation. The bottom circle is OUTER MANIFESTATION DOMAIN: Earth/matter/world/wide road, with Son at its center/bottom Door pole and Moon acting as reflected/cyclic mediator near its circumference. The Mandorla is the actual conversion field where inner becomes present/outer without the two domains becoming identical.
research_cautions: Do not call the mandorla historically 'the intersection of Heaven and Earth' unless the specific art-historical source says so; this is often a modern interpretation built on a real Christian sacred frame.
Do not claim ancient builders universally used a hidden Vesica master-grid. Documented construction geometry is stronger than secret-code claims.
Do not equate Hermetic Qabalah with historical Jewish Kabbalah without qualification.
Do not identify pineal with Ajna or thalamus with God's House as anatomical fact.
Do not treat Michelangelo neuroanatomy theories as settled consensus.
Do not merge biblical serpent imagery with Kundalini historically; preserve them as separate traditions with structural comparison only.
Do not use Moon symbolism to infer facts about people whose surname is Moon.
